BrochureContent.Content:
Nestled in the peaceful countryside on the stunning west coast of County Clare, this charming two-bedroom cottage offers a wonderful opportunity to enjoy rural living while remaining within easy reach of local amenities. Set on an impressive one-acre site, the property enjoys a tranquil setting just a 10-minute drive from the picturesque seaside town of Kilkee, renowned for its beautiful beaches, coastal walks, and vibrant community.

The accommodation comprises a kitchen, living room, utility room, shower room, and two well-proportioned bedrooms. While the cottage is presented in reasonable condition throughout, it offers excellent potential for further modernisation and enhancement, allowing the new owner to create a comfortable permanent residence, holiday home, or investment property.

Occupying a generous one-acre site, the property benefits from extensive outdoor space, including a large area to the rear that offers endless possibilities for landscaping, gardening, recreation, or future development (subject to the necessary planning permissions). A small adjoining shed provides useful additional storage or workshop space.

Combining the charm of a traditional countryside cottage with a superb coastal location, this property presents a rare opportunity to acquire a home with space, privacy, and significant potential in one of County Clare's most sought-after scenic areas.

Kitchen: 2.9 x 3.2. Laminate floor, wall and base units, hob, extractor fan, recess lights
Utility: 3.1 x 1.9. Laminate floor, sink, base units
Living Room: 4.8 x 3.0. Laminate floor, stove with back boiler, hotpress
Bedroom 1: 3.0 x 4.2. Carpet
Bedroom 2: 2.4 x 2.6. Carpet, curtains
Wetroom: Tiled floor, wc, whb, electric shower.

•	Quaint two-bed detached bungalow
